originality.rationale: The 2023 optimal single-step theorem (k=1) and maximum pair orbit L_n are explicitly prior. Exact n- and k-dependent near-noncontraction amplification with original single-step tolerance, sharp witness metrics at every time, and the least-period K_n appear in none of the inspected comparator statements.
